text_block_list.text:
A commemorative live performance 
celebrating the advancement of the horse 
girl world— Upon visiting the Student 
Council Room to deliver the demo data for 
the new song to be unveiled there...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of song it is~. I can't 
wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I heard the guide vocal track is arriving 
today, so... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, could that be the audio track for 
'Never Looking Back'!?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I was asked to deliver it to the 
President.

Yup. I was asked to deliver it to the 
President.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Prez is out right now, but I heard 
about it. I'll take custody of it for her!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The three of us are the vocalists for this 
new song! We were just having our initial 
meetup right now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled to be chosen to sing the 
new song! Aren't you excited, Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ............Yes... I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... Is it truly all right for 
someone like me to be chosen as a 
vocalist...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There are many others who are better 
singers and love performing on stage much 
more than I do...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's why you've had such a gloomy 
expression this whole time~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...But you know, vocalists aren't chosen 
just based on sheer singing skill, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's the song's image, vocal harmony... 
I'm sure there was a clear intention 
behind picking the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I don't have much confidence 
either, but... Since we were chosen, I 
want to give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Suzuka-san, Teio-san. You two 
were the very first friends I made when I 
came to Tracen Academy, so being with you 
both makes me super happy!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, no need to rush into an answer, 
right? We're gonna be practicing for the 
live either way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get right to it—time for our 
memorable first activity together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um, I'd really love to have a 
get-to-know-you party!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I kinda feel like moving around. What 
about you, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not really sure about these 
things... Um, which one would be 
better...?
choice_data_list: Moving around would count as practice too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
First things first, definitely a 
get-to-know-you party! Let's eat some 
snacks and chat!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A get-together... with food... I-I'm 
getting a really bad feeling about 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Cakes, puddings, parfaits, anmitsu, 
steamed meat buns, hamburgers... we have 
all sorts! Please eat up too, you two♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I kneeeew it!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me that whole plate over there 
is for me?! That looks like a whole day's 
worth of food?! If I eat all that at once, 
my stomach's gonna burst!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The meat is so juicy and delicious~! I 
really recommend this hamburger!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really does look delicious. You 
can have mine too, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure~? Then I won't hold back, 
thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Th-That was an option...?!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, eating a ton and chatting away was 
so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...For me too. Even though we share a 
room, there are surprisingly still things 
I didn't know about you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Thanks to Suzuka today, my 
belly avoided a total crisis too. I think 
the three of us are gonna have great 
teamwork!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If we know more about each other, we'll 
definitely be able to sing even better at 
the commemorative live!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If we know each other, it's easier 
to harmonize together...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure of it! A harmony that's unique to 
just us, or something like that. There 
definitely has to be!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A harmony just for us... a song for the 
three of us... Is that why I was 
chosen...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see what kind of song 
it'll be!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ............Yes, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Our 'Never Looking Back'... I want to hear 
it too——

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There are other songs in the commemorative 
live too, after all. Let's practice 
whenever we get the chance!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's do some light practice on catching 
off-beats today. Rhythm is super important 
for both singing and dancing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... the on-beat rhythm goes thump, 
thump, and the off-beat goes -thump, 
-thump, -thump... right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yep, exactly. The drill is simple: just 
jump on the off-beats in time with the 
music! Alright, let's give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Am I... doing it right~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Looking good, Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, well... -hop, -hop, -hop...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Suzuka, you switched back to on-beats 
halfway through. If you're getting mixed 
up, try jumping on the 'and' in '1 and 2 
and 3 and 4 and'.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Jump on the 'and' in 1 and 2 and... 
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: 1-hop, 2-hop, 3-hop, 4-hop ...How's that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... you got it... perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Suzuka-san, saying 'hop-hop' like 
that makes you look just like a cute 
little bunny~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Did I say 'hop' out loud...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You didn't even notice? You were 
counting out '1-hop, 2-hop'!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You're kidding, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it didn't sound strange at all! That 
way of counting makes it super easy to 
understand!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
True! Let's teach everyone this method 
during live practice!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so? If it helps, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Even when I struggle with something, it 
can still end up helping everyone's 
practice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm a genius, so sometimes I actually 
don't understand what it feels like when 
you can't do something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it is for you, Teio. 
...Maybe the reason I was included in 
vocals... lies in something like that 
too——
